statistics.rule: Average fixed mask draws within each trained seed, then mean and sample SD across three trained seeds.
statistics.baseline: none and diagonal_only are run once per trained seed; the same none baseline is used for all paired mask differences.
statistics.undefined: Any undefined mask rate makes that seed's mask mean undefined; n and n_undefined are explicit.
statistics.sd: Sample SD uses denominator n-1 across trained seeds; actors and masks are not independent training replicates.
statistics.difference: left minus right, paired within trained seed and mask before mask averaging

interpretation.dag: Keep self recurrence and a random-order directed acyclic off-diagonal graph.
interpretation.random: Same per-target retained edge counts as DAG; outgoing degree, spectrum, support and forcing are not matched.
interpretation.matched: DAG/random rows shrink to their shared smaller off-diagonal L2 norm, without amplifying weights; self weights remain exact.
interpretation.quarter: Interpolate 0.75 original + 0.25 matched endpoint. These gentler interventions retain cycles; endpoint row norm matching does not imply interpolated row norm matching.
interpretation.continuity: All forks inherit full h/world/clocks/pending contracts. Only copied recurrent parameters change; these forks are counterfactuals, not resets or training.
interpretation.statistics: Average three fixed mask draws within each trained seed; summarize across three trained seeds. Actors and mask draws are not independent training replicates.
interpretation.no_claim: No inference that a particular cycle length causes a behavior, or that no output under severe deletion means no memory.

limitations: Structural directed cycles establish possible feedback, not a causal share of behavior.
Frozen-state weighted closed walks can revisit neurons and repeat shorter cycles; they do not count simple cycles or measure multi-tick feedback.
DAG/random deletions match incoming counts and matched endpoints also match row L2 norms; outgoing degree, spectrum and state distributions remain unmatched.
Quarter interventions retain cycles and their interpolated row norms need not match.
Parameter intervention scores are counterfactuals. Only none is the unmodified existing model.
Three trained seeds provide descriptive means and sample SD, not a definitive causal estimate.
